description: This source file defines the KeyStoreFactory class, responsible for creating and configuring Java KeyStores with private keys and certificates.

classes.name: KeyStoreFactory
classes.description: A utility class for creating and configuring Java KeyStores, primarily supporting secure communications in the application.

methods.name: newKeystore
methods.description: Creates a new, empty Java KeyStore instance, initialized and ready for use.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Inserts a private key and corresponding certificates into the provided KeyStore.

methods.name: setCertificate
methods.description: Adds a certificate entry to the provided KeyStore.
